verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a SaaS billing platform like Paddle, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents ways for external agents (Claude, Cursor, Codex) to connect to Paddle: a hosted MCP server, a docs MCP server, and agent skills. Those belong to the separate MCP-server and agent-integration stories and earn no credit here, and nothing in the pack shows an AI assistant inside the Paddle dashboard or product itself.
